prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Begin Your Desktop Pet Journey", "Select the personality arc that best fits your daily workspace rhythm."]
1: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Upload photos from multiple angles for accurate 3D generation.", "Front View Photo", "Side View Photo"]
2: ["Name Your Companion", "Give your new pet a name to personalize their certificate.", "Companion Name", "Continue"]
3: ["Your Pet Has Arrived on Your Desktop!", "Look at your desktop to see your new companion exploring their space."]
4: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Desktop Pets", "Your account keeps all your companion pets, memories, and progress safe."]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your pet is officially adopted and ready to meet you.", "Official Adoption 2024"]
6: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Arrival", "Setting up animations, behaviors, and desktop interactions..."]
7: ["Don't worry — you can adjust pet behaviors and traits anytime from settings later."]
8: ["Upload High-Quality Pet Photos", "Well-lit photos taken at eye level generate the most realistic companion."]
9: ["Enable desktop notification so you get alerted when your pet is ready to interact."]
